name: Candied Kumquats In Syrup
instructions: Bring the sugar and water to a boil in a small saucepan over medium high heat and stir until the sugar has been dissolved
Reduce the heat to medium low
Add the kumquat slices and simmer until tender and almost translucent , about 15-20 minutes
Kumquats can be refrigerated in an airtight container up to 2 weeks
